duas.textArabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah
duas.textTranslation: We have reached the morning and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah. All praise is due to Allah.
duas.occasion: Said upon waking

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.textTransliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
duas.textTranslation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him.
duas.occasion: 100 times in morning — sins forgiven even if like foam of the sea

duas.textArabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.textTransliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammaati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.textTranslation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.occasion: Morning and evening

duas.textArabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.textTransliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer
duas.textTranslation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent.
duas.occasion: 100 times in morning — like freeing 10 slaves, 100 good deeds, and a shield from Shaytan

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter.
duas.occasion: Morning and evening

duas.textArabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah
duas.textTranslation: We have reached the evening and the whole kingdom belongs to Allah.
duas.occasion: Said in the evening

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.textTransliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
duas.textTranslation: Glory is to Allah and praise is to Him.
duas.occasion: 100 times in evening — sins forgiven

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِن شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِن شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma 'aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa maleekah, ash-hadu an la ilaha illa Ant, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-Shaytani wa shirkihi
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of everything, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil of Satan and his associates.
duas.occasion: In the evening

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bi min ni'matin aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, whatever blessing I have received this evening, or any of Your creation has received, is from You alone, with no partner. All praise and thanks are due to You.
duas.occasion: In the evening — whoever says it has fulfilled his thankfulness for the day

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ اللهِ ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ، وَاللهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.textTransliteration: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar
duas.textTranslation: Glory be to Allah, All praise is due to Allah, Allah is the Greatest.
duas.occasion: After each obligatory prayer

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta'khudhhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydeehim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuheetuna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma. Wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
duas.textTranslation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.occasion: After each obligatory prayer — whoever recites it will enter Paradise

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni 'ibadatik
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, help me to remember You, be grateful to You, and worship You in an excellent manner.
duas.occasion: After each prayer — the Prophet ﷺ advised Mu'adh to never leave this dua

duas.textArabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
duas.textTransliteration: Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah
duas.textTranslation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah. I seek the forgiveness of Allah. I seek the forgiveness of Allah.
duas.occasion: Immediately after completing each prayer

duas.textArabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.textTransliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Rabbina tawakkalna
duas.textTranslation: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
duas.occasion: When entering the home

duas.textArabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Bismillahi tawakkaltu 'alAllah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.textTranslation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might or power except with Allah.
duas.occasion: When leaving the home

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahummaf-tah li abwaba rahmatik
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
duas.occasion: When entering the mosque

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
duas.occasion: When leaving the mosque

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta'khudhhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydeehim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuheetuna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma. Wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
duas.textTranslation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.occasion: Recite for protection — whoever recites it at night, a guardian is appointed for them

duas.textArabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.textTransliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammaati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.textTranslation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

duas.textArabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.textTransliteration: Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad. Allahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
duas.textTranslation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born. Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
duas.occasion: Recite 3 times morning and evening for protection

duas.textArabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
duas.textTransliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
duas.textTranslation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak. From the evil of that which He created. And from the evil of darkness when it settles. And from the evil of the blowers in knots. And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
duas.occasion: Recite 3 times morning and evening for protection

duas.textArabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.textTransliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbin-nas. Malikin-nas. Ilahin-nas. Min sharril-waswasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
duas.textTranslation: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind. The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind. From the evil of the retreating whisperer. Who whispers in the breasts of mankind. Among jinn and among mankind.
duas.occasion: Recite 3 times morning and evening for protection

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنتَ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma Anta Rabbi la ilaha illa Anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana't, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa Ant
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant. I uphold Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me and I acknowledge my sins. Forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.
duas.occasion: Sayyidul Istighfar — whoever says this with conviction and dies that day enters Paradise

duas.textArabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayh
duas.textTranslation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him.
duas.occasion: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek forgiveness more than 70 times a day

duas.textArabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbana dhalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakoonanna minal-khasireen
duas.textTranslation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.occasion: The first dua for forgiveness taught by Allah to Adam and Hawwa

duas.textArabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُ؀ْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbighfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'mineena yawma yaqumul-hisab
duas.textTranslation: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
duas.occasion: Ibrahim's supplication — includes parents and all believers

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
duas.textTransliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakh-khara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrineen, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun
duas.textTranslation: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have accomplished this by ourselves. And to our Lord we will surely return.
duas.occasion: When starting a journey

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, we ask You on this journey for righteousness, piety, and deeds which please You.
duas.occasion: When embarking on a journey

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar
duas.textTranslation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest.
duas.occasion: When ascending a hill or incline during travel

duas.textArabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.textTransliteration: Ayibuna, ta'ibuna, 'abiduna, li Rabbina hamidun
duas.textTranslation: We return repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
duas.occasion: When returning from a journey

duas.textArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.textTransliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana minal-muslimeen
duas.textTranslation: All praise is due to Allah who fed us, gave us drink, and made us Muslims.
duas.occasion: Said after finishing a meal

duas.textArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ غَيْرَ مُوَدَّعٍ وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبُّنَا
duas.textTransliteration: Alhamdu lillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan feehi, ghayra muwadda'in wa la mustaghnan 'anhu Rabbuna
duas.textTranslation: All praise is due to Allah, abundant, pure, and blessed praise. It cannot be denied, nor can it be dispensed with, O our Lord.
duas.occasion: Said after finishing a meal — the Prophet ﷺ would say this after eating

duas.textArabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Bismillah
duas.textTranslation: In the name of Allah.
duas.occasion: Said before eating

duas.textArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.textTransliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
duas.textTranslation: Praise be to Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
duas.occasion: Said after finishing a meal — past sins are forgiven

duas.textArabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Bismillahi awwalahu wa akhirah
duas.textTranslation: In the name of Allah at the beginning and at the end.
duas.occasion: If you forgot to say Bismillah before eating

duas.textArabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Dhahaba ath-thama'u wab-tallat al-'urooqu wa thabat al-ajru in sha Allah
duas.textTranslation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.occasion: When breaking the fast (Iftar)

duas.textArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Alhamdulillah
duas.textTranslation: All praise is due to Allah.
duas.occasion: After drinking water or any beverage

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, forgive them, and have mercy on them.
duas.occasion: Said for the host after being fed and finishing a meal

duas.titleEnglish: Guest's Dua When Invited to Eat
duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma at'im man at'amani wasqi man saqani
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, feed the one who fed me and give drink to the one who gave me drink.
duas.occasion: Said by the guest when invited to eat at someone's home

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta'khudhhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydeehim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuheetuna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma. Wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
duas.textTranslation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.occasion: Recite before sleep — Allah appoints a guardian and no devil comes near until morning

duas.textArabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.textTransliteration: Bismika Allahumma amootu wa ahya
duas.textTranslation: In Your name O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.occasion: Said before going to sleep

duas.textArabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.textTransliteration: Tabarakal-ladhi biyadihil-mulku wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer
duas.textTranslation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent.
duas.occasion: Recite Surah Al-Mulk before sleep — it intercedes for its reader

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
duas.occasion: Before sleeping — the Prophet ﷺ would place his right hand under his cheek and say this

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.textTransliteration: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar
duas.textTranslation: Glory be to Allah, All praise to Allah, Allah is the Greatest.
duas.occasion: Recite SubhanAllah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times, Allahu Akbar 34 times before sleep

duas.textArabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.textTransliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'Adheemul-Haleem, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem
duas.textTranslation: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is no god but Allah, Lord of the Mighty Throne.
duas.occasion: When afflicted with grief or distress

duas.textArabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.textTransliteration: La ilaha illa Anta Subhanaka inni kuntu minaz-zalimeen
duas.textTranslation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.occasion: Dua of Prophet Yunus — no Muslim supplicates with it for anything without Allah responding

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl, wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from weakness and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from the burden of debts and from being overpowered by men.
duas.occasion: The Prophet ﷺ used to frequently recite this dua

duas.textArabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.textTransliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Hu, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem
duas.textTranslation: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
duas.occasion: Seven times morning and evening — Allah will suffice you in whatever concerns you

duas.titleArabic: لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
duas.textArabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.textTransliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.textTranslation: There is no power nor strength except with Allah.
duas.occasion: A treasure from the treasures of Paradise — said in times of distress

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahum-maghfir lahu warhamhu, wa 'afihi wa'fu 'anhu, wa akrim nuzulahu, wa wassi' mudkhalahu
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him, grant him well-being and pardon him, honour his resting place and widen his entrance.
duas.occasion: During the funeral prayer

duas.textArabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ
duas.textTransliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un
duas.textTranslation: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return.
duas.occasion: Upon hearing news of someone's passing

duas.textArabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ
duas.textTransliteration: As-salamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu'mineena wal-muslimeen, wa inna in sha Allahu bikum lahiqun
duas.textTranslation: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the graves, from among the believers and the Muslims. Indeed, if Allah wills, we will join you.
duas.occasion: When visiting the graveyard

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا
duas.textTransliteration: Allahum-maghfir lihayyina wa mayyitina, wa shahidina wa gha'ibina, wa sagheerina wa kabeerina, wa dhakarina wa unthana
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those who are present and those who are absent, our young and our old, our males and our females.
duas.occasion: During funeral prayer

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَلَا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu wa la taftinna ba'dahu waghfir lana wa lah
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward, do not try us after him, and forgive us and him.
duas.occasion: After someone's passing — part of the condolence prayer

duas.textArabic: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أَصُومَ غَدًا مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ الْمُبَارَكِ فَرْضًا لَكَ يَا اللَّهُ فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.textTransliteration: Nawaytu an asuma ghadan min shahri Ramadan al-mubarak, fardhan laka ya Allah, fataqabbal minni innaka antas-Samee'ul-'Aleem
duas.textTranslation: I intend to fast tomorrow in the blessed month of Ramadan, as an obligation for You, O Allah, so accept it from me. Indeed You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.occasion: Suhoor

duas.textArabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Dhahaba ath-thama'u wab-tallat al-'urooqu wa thabat al-ajru in sha Allah
duas.textTranslation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.occasion: Iftar

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma innaka 'afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'anni
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, You are the Most Forgiving, and You love forgiveness, so forgive me.
duas.occasion: Laylatul Qadr

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka birahmatik-allatee wasi'at kulla shay'in an taghfira lee
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which encompasses all things, to forgive me.
duas.occasion: Suhoor

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma laka sumtu wa 'ala rizqika aftartu
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, for You I have fasted and upon Your provision I have broken my fast.
duas.occasion: Iftar

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma-hdini fiman hadayt, wa 'afini fiman 'afayt, wa tawallani fiman tawallayt, wa barik li fima a'tayt, wa qini sharra ma qadayt
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, pardon me among those You have pardoned, turn to me among those You have turned, bless me in what You have given, and protect me from the evil of what You have decreed.
duas.occasion: Taraweeh

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-jannata wa a'udhu bika minan-nar
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I ask You for Paradise and seek refuge in You from the Fire.
duas.occasion: Laylatul Qadr

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, by Your grace we have reached the morning, by Your grace we reach the evening, by Your grace we live and by Your grace we die, and to You is the resurrection.
duas.occasion: Said every morning

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
duas.occasion: 10 times in the morning — the Prophet's intercession becomes due

duas.textArabic: وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
duas.textTransliteration: Wa ufawwidu amri ilAllah, innAllaha baseerun bil-'ibad
duas.textTranslation: And I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of His servants.
duas.occasion: Morning supplication — entrusting all affairs to Allah

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta'khudhhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydeehim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuheetuna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma. Wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
duas.textTranslation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.occasion: Recite in the evening for night protection

duas.textArabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.textTransliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer
duas.textTranslation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent.
duas.occasion: 100 times in evening — like freeing 10 slaves, 100 good deeds, and a shield from Shaytan

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
duas.occasion: 10 times in the evening — the Prophet's intercession becomes due

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, aati Muhammadanil-waseelata wal-fadeelah, wab'athhu maqaman mahmoodanil-ladhi wa'adtah
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer to be offered, grant Muhammad the intercession and favour, and raise him to the honourable station You have promised him.
duas.occasion: After hearing the adhan — whoever says this, my intercession becomes due for him

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabarakasmuka, wa ta'ala jadduka, wa la ilaha ghayruk
duas.textTranslation: Glory and praise be to You, O Allah. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god but You.
duas.occasion: After the opening takbeer of prayer, before reciting Al-Fatiha

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى
duas.textTransliteration: Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la
duas.textTranslation: Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.
duas.occasion: Said in sujud (prostration) — the closest a servant is to his Lord

duas.textArabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbighfir li warhamni wahdini wa 'afini warzuqni
duas.textTranslation: My Lord, forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, grant me well-being, and provide for me.
duas.occasion: Sitting between the two prostrations

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.textTransliteration: Subhana Rabbiyal-'Adheem
duas.textTranslation: Glory is to my Lord, the Almighty.
duas.occasion: Said in ruku (bowing)

duas.textArabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.textTransliteration: At-tahiyyatu lillahi was-salawatu wat-tayyibat, as-salamu 'alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh, as-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillahis-saliheen, ash-hadu an la ilaha illallahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh
duas.textTranslation: All greetings, prayers, and good things are due to Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah. I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and messenger.
duas.occasion: Recited in the sitting position (tashahhud) of every prayer

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba'ith
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female evil spirits.
duas.occasion: Before entering the bathroom

duas.textArabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Ghufranaka
duas.textTranslation: I seek Your forgiveness.
duas.occasion: After leaving the bathroom

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَحْسَنْتَ خَلْقِي فَأَحْسِنْ خُلُقِي
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma ahsanta khalqi fa ahsin khuluqi
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, You have made my appearance beautiful, so make my character beautiful.
duas.occasion: When looking in the mirror

duas.textArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.textTransliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi kasani hadha ath-thawba wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
duas.textTranslation: Praise be to Allah who clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength on my part.
duas.occasion: When wearing new clothes

duas.textArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Alhamdulillah
duas.textTranslation: All praise is due to Allah.
duas.occasion: Said when sneezing. The listener responds: 'Yarhamukallah' (May Allah have mercy on you), and the sneezer replies: 'Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum' (May Allah guide you and rectify your condition).

duas.textArabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
duas.textTransliteration: Subhanal-ladhi sakh-khara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrineen, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun
duas.textTranslation: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have accomplished this by ourselves. And to our Lord we will surely return.
duas.occasion: When riding any vehicle or mode of transport

duas.textArabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لَا يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.textTransliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu yuhyi wa yumeetu wa Huwa hayyun la yamutu, biyadihil-khayru wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer
duas.textTranslation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent.
duas.occasion: When entering a marketplace or shopping area

duas.textArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.textTransliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.textTranslation: All praise is due to Allah, who gave us life after causing us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
duas.occasion: The first words upon waking from sleep

duas.textArabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.textTransliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem
duas.textTranslation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan.
duas.occasion: When waking from a bad dream: seek refuge in Allah, spit lightly to your left three times, change the side you were sleeping on, and do not tell anyone about the dream.

duas.textArabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.textTransliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer. SubhanAllah walhamdu lillah wa la ilaha illallahu wallahu Akbar wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
duas.textTranslation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent. Glory be to Allah, all praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no power nor strength except with Allah.
duas.occasion: When waking during the night — whoever says this and then supplicates will be answered

duas.textArabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.textTransliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammah min kulli shaytanin wa hammah wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
duas.textTranslation: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every envious evil eye.
duas.occasion: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn with these words

duas.textArabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.textTransliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min kulli shaytanin wa hammah wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
duas.textTranslation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every envious evil eye.
duas.occasion: For protection against the evil eye and harmful creatures

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma Rabbas-samawatis-sab'i wa ma adhlalna, wa Rabbal-aradeenas-sab'i wa ma aqlalna, wa Rabbash-shayateeni wa ma adlalna, wa Rabbar-riyahi wa ma dharayna, as'aluka khayra hadhihil-qaryati wa khayra ahliha wa khayra ma feeha, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ahliha wa sharri ma feeha
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven earths and all they carry, Lord of the devils and all they mislead, Lord of the winds and all they scatter, I ask You for the good of this town and the good of its people and the good of what is in it, and I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of its people, and the evil of what is in it.
duas.occasion: When entering a new town or city

duas.textArabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.textTransliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.textTranslation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.occasion: When stopping at any place during travel — nothing will harm you until you depart from that place

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُلِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي وَنُورَ صَدْرِي وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni 'abduka ibnu 'abdika ibnu amatik, nasiyati biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, 'adlun fiyya qada'uk, as'aluka bikulli ismin huwa laka sammayta bihi nafsaka aw anzaltahu fi kitabika aw 'allamtahu ahadan min khalqika awista'tharta bihi fi 'ilmil-ghaybi 'indaka an taj'alal-Qur'ana rabee'a qalbi wa nura sadri wa jala'a huzni wa dhahaba hammi
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant. My forelock is in Your hand, Your command over me is forever executed, and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You have named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or taught to any of Your creation, or kept in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the departure of my sorrow, and the release of my anxiety.
duas.occasion: A comprehensive dua for distress — whoever says it, Allah will replace his sorrow with joy

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma-kfini bihalalika 'an haramika wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have made unlawful, and enrich me with Your bounty so I need no one besides You.
duas.occasion: When overwhelmed by debt or financial hardship

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni astakheeruka bi'ilmika wa astaqdiruka biqudratika wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'adheem, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdiru wa ta'lamu wa la a'lamu wa Anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun li fi deeni wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li feehi, wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi deeni wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anhu waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bih
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by virtue of Your knowledge, and I seek ability by virtue of Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty. You have power and I have none. You know and I know not. You are the Knower of hidden things. O Allah, if in Your knowledge this matter is good for my religion, my livelihood and my affairs, then ordain it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. And if in Your knowledge this matter is bad for my religion, my livelihood and my affairs, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and ordain for me the good wherever it may be, and make me content with it.
duas.occasion: After praying two rak'ahs of voluntary prayer when seeking guidance on a decision

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma-hdini wa saddidni
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, guide me and direct me to the right path.
duas.occasion: A general dua for guidance in daily decisions

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I ask You for all good, immediate and delayed, that which I know of and that which I do not know. And I seek refuge in You from all evil, immediate and delayed, that which I know of and that which I do not know.
duas.occasion: When seeking clarity between choices or facing uncertainty

duas.textArabic: لَا بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.textTransliteration: La ba'sa, tahoorun in sha Allah
duas.textTranslation: No worry, it is a purification, if Allah wills.
duas.occasion: Said when visiting a sick person to comfort them

duas.textArabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.textTransliteration: Bismillah, a'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir
duas.textTranslation: In the name of Allah. I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and what I fear.
duas.occasion: Place your hand on the area of pain, say Bismillah three times, then recite this dua seven times

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi Antash-Shafi la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the affliction. Heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves no illness behind.
duas.occasion: Recite for yourself or when making dua for a sick person

duas.textArabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Bismillahi arqeek, min kulli shay'in yu'dheek, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni hasidin Allahu yashfeek, bismillahi arqeek
duas.textTranslation: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah on you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye may Allah heal you, in the name of Allah I perform ruqyah on you.
duas.occasion: Recited over a sick person for spiritual healing

duas.textArabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.textTransliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un, Allahumma-jurni fi museebati wa akhlif li khayran minha
duas.textTranslation: Indeed we belong to Allah and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it with something better.
duas.occasion: When afflicted with illness or any calamity

duas.textArabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbir-hamhuma kama rabbayani sagheera
duas.textTranslation: My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up when I was small.
duas.occasion: A dua for parents taught by Allah in the Quran

duas.textArabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbanagh-fir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'mineena yawma yaqumul-hisab
duas.textTranslation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
duas.occasion: Ibrahim's supplication for his parents and all believers

duas.textArabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqeena imama
duas.textTranslation: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us leaders for the righteous.
duas.occasion: A comprehensive dua for family wellbeing and righteousness

duas.textArabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.textTransliteration: Barakallahu laka wa baraka 'alayka wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr
duas.textTranslation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
duas.occasion: Said to congratulate newlyweds

duas.textArabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqeena imama
duas.textTranslation: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us leaders for the righteous.
duas.occasion: When seeking a righteous spouse or praying for one's marriage

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma allif bayna quloobina wa aslih dhata baynina
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, bring our hearts together and mend the relations between us.
duas.occasion: For harmony and love between spouses

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa khayra ma jabaltaha 'alayh, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma jabaltaha 'alayh
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I ask You for the good in her and the good in the disposition You have given her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil in her and the evil in the disposition You have given her.
duas.occasion: Said by the husband on the wedding night while placing his hand on his wife's forehead

duas.textArabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.textTransliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammah min kulli shaytanin wa hammah wa min kulli 'aynin lammah
duas.textTranslation: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every envious evil eye.
duas.occasion: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek protection for Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn with these words

duas.textArabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka samee'ud-du'a
duas.textTranslation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
duas.occasion: Zakariyya's supplication for righteous children

duas.textArabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Barakallahu laka fil-mawhubi laka, wa shakarta al-wahib, wa balagha ashuddahu, wa ruziqta birrahu
duas.textTranslation: May Allah bless you with what He has given you, and may you give thanks to the Giver, and may the child reach full maturity, and may you be blessed with their righteousness.
duas.occasion: Said to congratulate parents on the birth of a new child

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an wa rizqan tayyiban wa 'amalan mutaqabbala
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
duas.occasion: After the Fajr prayer — a comprehensive morning supplication for knowledge

duas.textArabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma
duas.textTranslation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.occasion: Before studying, reading, or seeking any form of knowledge

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَهِّمْنِي فِي الدِّينِ وَعَلِّمْنِي التَّأْوِيلَ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma fahhimni fid-deen wa 'allimni at-ta'weel
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, grant me understanding of the religion and teach me the interpretation.
duas.occasion: When seeking deeper understanding of religious knowledge

duas.textArabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.textTransliteration: Labbayk Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la shareeka lak
duas.textTranslation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed, all praise and blessings are Yours, and the dominion. You have no partner.
duas.occasion: Recited throughout Hajj and Umrah from the meeqat onwards

duas.textArabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.textTransliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadeer
duas.textTranslation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent.
duas.occasion: The best supplication is on the Day of Arafat

duas.textArabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
duas.textTranslation: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.occasion: Between the Yemeni corner and the Black Stone during tawaf

duas.textArabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Innas-Safa wal-Marwata min sha'a'irillah
duas.textTranslation: Indeed, Safa and Marwa are among the symbols of Allah.
duas.occasion: Recited when beginning the Sa'ee between Safa and Marwa

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'a
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, let it be a beneficial rain.
duas.occasion: Said when rain begins to fall

duas.textArabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Mutirna bifadlillahi wa rahmatihi
duas.textTranslation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
duas.occasion: Said after the rain stops

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa khayra ma feeha wa khayra ma ursilat bih, wa a'udhu bika min sharriha wa sharri ma feeha wa sharri ma ursilat bih
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, I ask You for its good, the good of what it contains, and the good of what it has been sent with. And I seek refuge in You from its evil, the evil of what it contains, and the evil of what it has been sent with.
duas.occasion: When there is strong wind — do not curse the wind, for it is commanded by Allah

duas.textArabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ
duas.textTransliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'matakal-lati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardah
duas.textTranslation: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteousness of which You approve.
duas.occasion: A Quranic supplication for gratitude — also used by Sulayman

duas.textArabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
duas.textTransliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi bini'matihi tatimmus-salihat
duas.textTranslation: All praise is due to Allah, by whose grace good deeds are completed.
duas.occasion: When receiving good news or when something pleasing happens

duas.textArabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
duas.textTransliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr
duas.textTranslation: O Allah, to You belongs all praise and to You belongs all gratitude.
duas.occasion: When feeling pleased or content — expressing gratitude to Allah
